assessment: This important study makes the case that the assembly of MreB from Geobacillus, a Gram-positive organism differs substantially from MreB from the Gram-negative model organism, Escherichia coli. They make the compelling case that Geobacillus MreB assembly requires both interactions with membrane lipids and nucleotide binding: nucleotide hydrolysis is required for interaction with the membrane and interaction with lipids triggers polymerization. Altogether, these data make the strong case that MreB assembly dynamics can vary in significant, and organism-specific ways.
